gui.pleasurehorizons.guide_book.title: Pleasure Horizons Guide
guide.pleasurehorizons.welcome:
Welcome to Pleasure Horizons!
This book explains the girls, gifts, scenes,
quests and gadget items added by the mod.
guide.pleasurehorizons.girls:
Girls live in your world. Tame them and
they follow, work, guard and accompany you.
Use the Girl Wand to rename, heal, interact
and give quests.
guide.pleasurehorizons.gifts:
Gifts raise affection.
Each gift shows how much it is worth.
Higher affection unlocks closer dialogue,
scenes and quest rewards.
guide.pleasurehorizons.scenes:
Scenes are special interactions unlocked by
relationship level. Start them from a girl's
inventory. Higher levels unlock more options.
guide.pleasurehorizons.quests:
Quests come from the NPC editor.
Collect, kill or escort to complete them.
Rewards raise affection and often give items.
guide.pleasurehorizons.items:
Gadget items:
Memory Crystal — bind and recall home.
Summoning Whistle — call your closest girl.
Healing Charm — heals girls in your inventory.
